result.reason: The redline adopts New York governing law but does not establish fully exclusive New York County jurisdiction. It limits the forum provision to proceedings “not resolved by arbitration,” while retaining language allowing an arbitral award to be confirmed in any court of competent jurisdiction, including the federal district where the losing party resides. That express alternative venue conflicts with the playbook position. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve the existing arbitration framework, but the operative language and margin comment overstate compliance.
